{{Top}}
A '''fusion generator''' was a type of ubiquitous [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] that provided power to [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Characteristics==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], some cultures constructed generators so small that could be carried in backpacks. In later ages, such as the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], such technologies had been forgotten and had to make do with bigger sizes.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

The most popular source of starship power, cold-ionization fusion reactors fused matter at room temperature, creating massive amounts of energy without emitting large amounts of heat.<ref name="COMPLETE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The fusion reactor then sent the energy it generated to cryogenic power cells for storage.<ref name="COMPLETE" /> Fusion reactors were a necessity for propelling large starships through [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="COMPLETE" /><ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

[[Power droid/Legends|Power droids]] were ambulatory fusion generators.<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|POW 1-2|Power Droids}}</ref> The ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' was powered by a fusion reactor.
